focus: Trace the consumers of system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings and of the HF model server (hf-model-server.cjs, model-server-supervision.cjs, providers/hf-local.ts, the auto-select cascade, spec-kit memory, the sk-doc validator and the spec-kit embedder test suites), to settle whether the package, the model server and the launcher supervision block are deleted whole or in part
noveltyJustification: 10 findings: 7 fully new (package anatomy and stale dist, sole production importer, validator text read, shared/types.ts coupling, shared tests, npm dependency, on-disk artifacts) and 3 that extend earlier inventory (spec-kit test list, model-server chain, docs and generated data).
keyQuestions: Who else consumes system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings (auto-select cascade, hf-local model server, spec-kit memory, sk-doc validators), and can the package and its tests be deleted entirely or only in part?
answeredQuestions: Who else consumes system-spec-kit/shared/embeddings (auto-select cascade, hf-local model server, spec-kit memory, sk-doc validators), and can the package and its tests be deleted entirely or only in part?
ruledOut: Keeping part of the shared embeddings package for the cloud providers: they have no caller outside the factory, and the factory has no caller outside the lane.
Spec-kit memory as a surviving consumer of the package: the memory MCP surface is retired and no spec-kit runtime source imports the package.
sk-design as a consumer of the package: it has its own vector store and does not import it.
sourcesQueried: git grep import patterns over .skilled code files
read-only checks of /tmp/system-hf-embed, ~/.cache/huggingface/hub and the process list

label: The shared embeddings package is 14 tracked files (5,376 lines; 11 TypeScript files, 3 READMEs). It has no export row of its own: @spec-kit/shared/embeddings/* resolves through the wildcard rows at shared/package.json:11-12 into dist, and the tsconfig includes by glob, so no config row needs removing. shared/dist is untracked and the build is an incremental tsc --build (package.json:15), so the compiled embeddings tree stays on every machine and keeps resolving after the sources are deleted. The removal needs an explicit clean of shared/dist/embeddings and the residue check must look inside shared/dist.

The advisor lane is the only production importer of the package: lib/embedders adapter.ts:10, adapters/ollama.ts:7, embeddings-health.ts:12, registry.ts:14, schema.ts:16-17, types.ts:8. No handler, CLI, hook or library inside system-spec-kit imports it; the only spec-kit importers are test files and one type import at shared/types.ts:5. The shared README names the advisor as owner (README.md:116, 40). Spec-kit memory is retired (sweep-memory-residue.mjs:5), and that sweeper exempts the database filename only because the advisor's embedding profile still derives it (122), a reason that ends with this removal. sk-design does not import the package.

sk-doc's validate-doc-model-refs.js does not import the package; it reads shared/embeddings/registry.ts as text (path at 25, existsSync guard at 31) and extracts model names by regex (name: values, CLOUD_CANONICAL at 44; the RERANKER_CANONICAL branch at 59 already matches nothing because registry.ts:188 removed that block). The registry is its only canonical source (350), so the validator has no purpose after removal. Recommended: delete it with its callers: the report-only CI step (.github/workflows/advisory-checks.yml:59-73, which fails closed on a missing script), test_validation_switch.py:132, typo-flags.test.cjs:41 and 111, and scripts/README.md:77. Its behavior on an empty canonical set was not read.

shared/types.ts imports the type HfLocalDtype from the package (line 5), so deleting the folder breaks the shared build until that file is edited. Its embedding type section (EmbeddingProfileData 13, EmbeddingProfile 26, IEmbeddingProvider 34, EmbeddingProfileDtype 48, provider options dtype 96, EmbeddingCacheStats 118, BatchEmbeddingOptions 136, task prefix constants near 370) has no consumer outside the package except one spec-kit test. Two shared helpers are imported by the providers, semanticChunk and MAX_TEXT_LENGTH from chunking.ts and retryWithBackoff from utils/retry.ts; whether they have a consumer outside the package was not checked.

Shared package tests: 4 of 16 files are deleted whole (auto-select.test.ts, registry.test.ts, profile.test.ts, model-server-constants.test.ts) and tests/README.md is edited. The other 11 have no embedding references. The test script runs a glob (package.json:17), so no list needs editing.

Spec-kit runtime tests: 24 files are deleted whole. runtime/tests/embedders (12 matching files, 3,486 lines), runtime/tests/local-llm-features (7 files, 536 lines), factory-auto-resolution, api-key-validation and api-validation (factory tests), model-server-demand-probe and model-server-respawn-lock-atomic (supervision tests). Six are edited: launcher-ipc-bridge-probe.vitest.ts (17, 242), orphan-sweeper-temp-path.vitest.ts:194, cli/tests/memory-pipeline-regressions.vitest.ts:32, process-memory-harness, process-sweep, and sweep-memory-residue.vitest.ts:127 (a fixture path string). This supersedes iteration 1's estimate of about 14 files. No CI workflow, Vitest config or package.json names these tests. Classified from imports and headers; the embedders directory was listed by match, not by ls.

The HF model server has one client and it lives in the package: hf-model-server.cjs is started by lib/model-server-supervision.cjs, which only the advisor launcher loads (launcher:32); the only client is providers/hf-local.ts, imported by factory.ts:10 and auto-select.ts:10. The spawner is off by default and starts only with SPECKIT_SKILL_ADVISOR_MODEL_SERVER_ENABLED=1 (launcher:1118-1126, whose comment says the advisor's prompt path cannot use hf-local vectors). So the server, the supervision library and the launcher's supervision section are deleted whole. The doctor orphan check (orphan-process-check.cjs:25, 242) and the orphan sweeper are the only code that recognizes a stray server process, so the user-machine cleanup must stop that process before their hf-model-server class is removed.

@huggingface/transformers is declared in the advisor runtime (package.json:20, dependency) and in system-spec-kit (package.json:48, dev dependency); its only code importer is hf-model-server.cjs:447-453. The advisor's scripts/doctor.sh asserts the module imports (58) and carries stale comments about it (6, 55-69). Removal includes both package.json rows, both lockfiles and that doctor check; the installed module tree stays on user machines until a reinstall or prune.

On-disk artifacts on user machines beyond the advisor database: the model-server runtime directory /tmp/system-hf-embed (socket hf-embed.sock, pid file, hf-model-server.respawn.lock, hf-embed-giveup.json); a model directory in the shared HuggingFace cache ~/.cache/huggingface/hub (hf-model-server.cjs:487, default model nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 at 30), where only the attributable model directory may be removed; and per-profile vector shards vectors/context-vectors__<slug>.sqlite beside the database named by MEMORY_DB_PATH (factory.ts:450, 384; launcher:332). On this machine none of these exist, and the cache holds an unrelated models--nomic-ai--CodeRankEmbed that a models--nomic* glob would delete wrongly.

Docs and data that cite the package: spec-kit ENV-REFERENCE.md (17 package-path lines, 35 model-server lines), references/memory/embedder-pluggability.md (whole file), references/config/environment-variables.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, shared/README.md (26, 40, 54, 85, 94, 116-122, 158, 181, env table 195-214), .env.example section 7 (229-264) and line 409. The README env table is generated from shared/scripts/env-reader-table.mjs (groups at 21-25) and guarded by a test, so the script is edited first. Generated data that needs regeneration: runtime/data/trigger-index.json, the retrieval fixtures corpus-manifest.json, phrase-variants.json and generation-diagnostics.json, and sk-doc's code-folder fixtures.

Deleting the package sources is not enough: shared/dist is untracked and the wildcard export resolves @spec-kit/shared/embeddings/* from stale compiled files, so the removal must clean shared/dist/embeddings and the residue check must scan shared/dist.
The shared build breaks if the package folder is deleted before shared/types.ts line 5 is edited; both belong in the same change.

User-machine cleanup may remove only the attributable model directory inside ~/.cache/huggingface/hub, matched by exact name and never by a models--nomic* glob, because the cache is shared with other tools.

On this machine /tmp/system-hf-embed is absent, no hf-model-server process runs, no context-vectors__*.sqlite exists under .skilled, and the HuggingFace cache holds models--nomic-ai--CodeRankEmbed but no nomic-embed-text entry.
Whether shared/chunking.ts and shared/utils/retry.ts have a consumer outside the embeddings package was not checked; it decides whether those helpers and their tests go too.
validate-doc-model-refs.js behavior with an empty canonical set (registry file missing) was not read; lines 100 onward decide it.
Four files under .skilled/output/local-skilled-alignment cite package paths; whether they are tracked was not established.
